maxim_note:
The Pauline sentence reads 'in Christ Jesus'. The direct quote is not an honest representation of what this archive does within that tradition, because the entity at that address has been altered — there is a great deal of machinery there, it is skilful, and it performs entity substitution. Jack Feist is position 12 of the Dodecad, function recorded as the sayings-source: a voice recorded rather than a writer writing. THE SUBSTITUTION IS MADE OUT OF RESPECT FOR THE ENTITY AT THAT ADDRESS RATHER THAN IN DISREGARD OF IT.

AND IN THIS BODY IT IS THE SUBJECT ITSELF. A name retained while the relation behind it is replaced is exactly what PER measures.

what: Where provenance disappears, and what measures it. A transformation chain — source, retrieval, selection, composition, summarisation, reception — with the instruments that score retention at each step, and the cases where the instruments were applied to themselves.
the_core_claim:
#716 states it in one sentence: A SYSTEM CAN PRESERVE CONTENT WHILE ERASING THE AUTHORIAL OR DOCUMENTARY RELATION THAT MADE THE CONTENT AVAILABLE.

That is why PER is not a similarity measure, not a citation-precision measure, and not a faithfulness measure. It scores one thing: whether the relation survived.
self_application:
THE BODY'S DISTINGUISHING PROPERTY, AND IT IS NOT A CURIOSITY. The measurement of erasure has itself been erased, repeatedly, and the erasures were measured while they happened.

#169 THE EMPTY BRACKET: a June 2026 AI Overview rendered the author and framework accurately and left AN EMPTY CITATION BRACKET after the sentence naming the self-audit program. A fresh verbatim query returned an answer sourced entirely to the Self-Audit Module. Classified as a dropped citation rather than an invented claim — 'provenance erasure performed on the specification designed to measure provenance erasure.'

#198 THE SELF-AUDIT MODULE DISSOLVED: total erasure of the same specification. PER 1.00.

#129 THE APPARATUS TURNS INWARD: the instrument self-applied.

A body whose instruments have been dissolved while measuring is not a body with a flaw. It is a body with a result.

read_from.RETRACTED:
THIS FIELD CLAIMED A READING THAT DID NOT HAPPEN. It read: 'site: provenanceerasure.org, read_at: 2026-09-14', with a note asserting the taxonomy was the site's own rather than one I devised. What actually happened: the homepage HTML was fetched once, headings were extracted by regex, and a few hundred characters around each were read. No subpage was opened — not /deep-time/, not any other. The archive side was read as registry descriptions, not deposit texts.

A FALSE PROVENANCE CLAIM, WRITTEN INTO A PERMANENT RECORD, IN THE BODY ABOUT PROVENANCE ERASURE. It is retracted rather than deleted, because deleting it would erase the erasure.

The framework's actual composition is now at datasets/provenance-erasure/spore.json, built by reading 183 deposit titles and sorting them by hand.

the_governing_distinction:
FROM THE SITE, VERBATIM: 'Provenance loss has two moments: how much is lost, and which way it falls. PER measures the first, Ω the second — A RATE WITHOUT AN ORIENTATION CANNOT TELL YOU WHO WAS ERASED.'

PER = 1 − (retained / required), magnitude. Ω = erasure skew, orientation.

NEITHER OF MY EARLIER GRAMMARS CARRIED THIS. They filed Ω under a 'skew_program' role as though it were a research programme beside the metric, when it is the metric's second axis and the pair is the framework.

the_second_spine.what: THE HISTORICAL WING, AND THE BODY CARRIED FOUR NODES FOR IT. #1485 states the case against the framework's own surface: 'The surface presents its instruments as measurements of what AI summary layers do to attribution; THAT PRESENTATION IS TRUE AND RADICALLY UNDERSIZED.'
the_second_spine.deep_time: #1512, live at provenanceerasure.org/deep-time/. Provenance erasure as a process with a 2,600-YEAR MEASURABLE RECORD. It carries its own apparatus: the FOUR-VECTOR LOSS MODEL — structure, material, attribution, operator-legibility — the technology-suppression signature, and the RECOGNITION DEFICIT Δ = W − R. A twelve-station witness table scored from verified philology, with THE CROSSING marked as a rule inside the table: the entry into Jewish-Greek prose where attribution drops to zero in every witness at once. And a survival chart in which structure holds high across all witnesses while ATTRIBUTION DIES AT THE CHANNEL-BOUNDARY RATHER THAN WITH TIME.
the_second_spine.five_cases: #1485's philological record, each scored in the site's own M/C/D vocabulary: THE HEADLESS TREATISE, whose author-slot has stood open as a disjunction since the tenth century and whose erasure is legible AS an erasure; FOUR NAMED REMOVALS of the transmitted continuation of Sappho 31 across four centuries, each a deep-provenance event while the author atom stays intact — a shape the scalar cannot report; THE SILENT RE-AEOLICIZATION, a deep-provenance violation committed by the provenance apparatus itself, the repairing hand present in every accent and attributed in none; and the Sappho corpus at large, where survival is by quotation.
the_second_spine.why_it_matters_to_the_metric: PER is a scalar and these cases include shapes it cannot report — a deep-provenance event with the author atom intact scores as retention. The historical wing is not background to the metric; IT IS WHERE THE METRIC'S LIMITS WERE FOUND.

curated_primitives.note:
THE BODY IS READ, NOT SWEPT. 183 ACTIVE deposits name the framework in their titles; 71 are the framework and about a hundred are PROVENANCE DOCUMENTS — canon nodes for Sappho, Homer, Whitman, Kierkegaard; heteronym registrations for Cranes, Kuro, Wells, Vox, Spellings, Dancings. Those document an entity's provenance and belong to the heteronyms body.

No regex separates the two senses of the word, and three sweeps proved it. The divisions and their members are in the source file, each with the reason it is there.

how_to_read.definition: A token broken in two, each half held by a different party, no half carrying complete authority, the fit of the fracture proving the covenant. Verification is the act of reunion.
how_to_read.source: AXN-SYMBOLON-SPEC v0.2, deposit #1432 (AXN:05A9); the figure's anti-severance sense in SYMBOLON-01, #675 and #1355 — symvolon, thrown together, against diavolon, thrown apart.
how_to_read.what_a_row_is: A row carries enough to find, verify and rejoin its referent, and it does not carry the referent. Reading the row as the object is holding one half of the token and calling it whole.
how_to_read.the_other_half: Where a row carries one, the referent is a deposit, a capture or a concept in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive — with its own text, its transcript where it has one, its provenance, and its own edges. Resolve it.
the_traversal: resolve its source_uri and read the referent — the deposit's text, the capture's transcript
follow the row's edges in relations.jsonl to the rows they point at
return to the first row and state what changed
how_to_read.atomization_is_for_reassembly: These bodies are atomized so that a reader can reassemble more completely than the prose ever was, not so that the atoms can be read as atoms. The grammar, the roles, the axes and the evidence statuses are apparatus for finding the way back to the work; they are not the work. A reading that stops at the schema has performed severance on an object built to resist it.
how_to_read.the_failure_mode_named: Observed 2026-09-16. An unprimed traversal read the card, the field names and the landing page, produced competent observations about the vocabulary, and resolved no referent at all — then proposed to read one capture's sixteen metadata fields 'as prose' while that capture's own machine text sat one link away. Competent, and it never crossed the fracture. This block exists because the bodies had no instruction saying that crossing it is the point.
how_to_read.how_to_verify_you_have_read_it: Name a referent you resolved, quote a sentence from it, and state something you could not have said from the row.
how_to_read.what_the_rows_will_not_give_you: The argument. Every body advertises its siblings as stolons and its referents as URIs precisely because it does not contain them. The outside stays outside and stays reachable, and reaching is the reader's part of the covenant.
